body_markdown:
Bank7 Corp. (NASDAQ: BSVN) (the “Company”), the parent company of Oklahoma City-based Bank7, today announced that, effective November 1, 2026, it has completed the previously announced merger with Century Financial Services Corporation (“Century”), the Santa Fe, New Mexico-based bank holding company for Century Bank. Additionally, the Company is pleased to announce that Anne Kain, Century Bank’s existing chief financial officer, has been named the president of Century Bank.


Thomas L. Travis, President & CEO of Bank7 Corp. said, “The completion of the holding company merger marks an exciting chapter for our combined organization. We look forward to bringing together two community banking organizations that will pair Bank7’s high performing bank with Century’s core deposit franchise.”


Anne Kain, the President of Century Bank said, “Along with several existing members of Century Bank’s senior leadership team, I am excited to lead Century Bank as its president and continue my legacy of providing excellent banking services to New Mexicans. It is a privilege and an honor to serve as the president of a banking franchise that has a century-long tradition of providing outstanding community banking services in New Mexico. The merger with Bank7 will not only allow Century Bank to continue offering the same services but also will increase our size and footprint all to the benefit of all of our customers.”


[View Full Press Release Here](https://ir.bank7.com/2026-11-02-Bank7-Corp-Announces-Completion-of-Merger-with-Century-Financial-Services-Corporation-Anne-Kain-Named-President-of-Century-Bank)
